shortBio.en: Led Zeppelin bassist/keyboardist/arranger; later resurfaced with Grohl and Homme in Them Crooked Vultures.
shortBio.zh: Led Zeppelin 贝斯手/键盘手/编曲；后与 Grohl、Homme 出现在 Them Crooked Vultures。

whyHub.en: Zeppelin’s arrangement spine—then a 2009 hard-rock cross-link via Them Crooked Vultures.
whyHub.zh: Zeppelin 的编曲脊梁——再经 Them Crooked Vultures 做 2009 hard-rock 交叉链接。

body.en:
Born 1946. Session arranging background feeds Zeppelin’s folk-to-heavy dynamics, bass lines, and keyboard textures. Rarely chased frontman myth; structural credit is the hub value.

Them Crooked Vultures shows late-career mobility among hard-rock peers.
body.zh:
1946 年生。录音室编曲背景喂养 Zeppelin 从民谣到重型的动态、贝斯线与键盘纹理。很少追逐主唱神话；结构 credits 即枢纽价值。

Them Crooked Vultures 展示 hard-rock 同辈间的后期职业流动。
